content: Go time gotchas verified: Go 1.9+ time values carry a monotonic reading; wall clock can jump while monotonic does not - mixing time.Now() wall reads with Sub/Since comparisons across a boundary produces inconsistent results (Cloudflare outage pre-Go1.9). bwmarrin issue #9: OS timer granularity (Windows 15.6ms) made same-ms IDs repeat in tests. Time-dependent tests must inject a fake clock into the generator (constructor seam) rather than calling time.Now() deep inside, and concurrency tests must run with -race (issue #15 shows race detector catches generator bugs t.Parallel exposes).
